characters.bio: A test pilot for Ferris Aircraft who found a dying alien's power ring and became the greatest Green Lantern of them all. Fearless to a fault, inspiring to everyone else.
characters.name: Hal Jordan
characters.tagline: The Corps' greatest — and most reckless — Lantern.

characters.bio: An architect and former U.S. Marine chosen for his discipline and precision of thought. Where Hal improvises, John plans — the steady hand of the Corps.
characters.name: John Stewart

characters.bio: Loud, proud, and utterly fearless — the Corps' resident brawler. All attitude on the surface, all heart underneath.
characters.name: Guy Gardner

characters.bio: A freelance artist handed a power ring when the Corps had nearly fallen. He carried the torch alone, then helped rebuild everything.
characters.name: Kyle Rayner

characters.bio: A towering Bolovaxian who has trained generations of rookies. Gruff, loyal, and unforgettable — nobody forgets their first day with Kilowog.
characters.name: Kilowog

characters.bio: Once the Green Lantern Corps' most celebrated member, exiled for ruling his sector through fear. He forged the yellow light into a Corps of his own — order, at any cost.
characters.name: Sinestro

characters.bio: A savage warrior of Vorn recruited for his gift for inspiring terror. The Sinestro Corps' answer to Kilowog — all muscle, all menace.
characters.name: Arkillo

characters.bio: Sole survivor of his sector's massacre, who nursed his rage across the ages until the red light answered. Founder of the Red Lantern Corps.
characters.name: Atrocitus

characters.bio: A winged warrior whose fury made her one of the Red Lanterns' most formidable members. Her rage is as beautiful as it is terrible.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)
characters.name: Bleez
characters.tagline: Winged fury of the Red Lanterns.

characters.bio: An abandoned housecat whose rage at a cruel world earned him a red ring. Small, adorable, and utterly lethal.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)
characters.name: Dex-Starr

characters.bio: A miserable wretch who claimed the orange light of avarice for himself — all of it, forever. He wants it ALL, and he is not sharing.
characters.name: Larfleeze

characters.bio: A gentle soul from a dying world who became the first Blue Lantern. Where others preach hope, he simply is it.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)
characters.name: Saint Walker

characters.bio: The enigmatic bearer of the indigo staff, leading a tribe that channels compassion itself. Her past is a mystery the light keeps.
characters.name: Indigo-1

characters.bio: Heiress of Ferris Aircraft and Hal Jordan's great love, chosen by the violet light of love. A queen caught between heart and duty.
characters.name: Carol Ferris

characters.bio: A lifelong Green Lantern foe obsessed with death, chosen as the herald of the Black Lantern Corps. Where he points, the dead rise.
characters.name: Black Hand

characters.bio: Death given will and voice — the power behind the Blackest Night itself. The darkness every light was made to hold back.
characters.firstAppearance: Tales of the Green Lantern Corps #2 (1981)
characters.name: Nekron
Zilius Zox
characters.bio: A hulking brute of the same species as the fallen Green Lantern Galius Zed. Zilius Zox is rage in its purest, simplest form.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)

characters.name: Rankorr
characters.bio: Jack Moore was an ordinary young man until grief and fury earned him a red ring. The most human heart in the most inhuman Corps.
